payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear rationale for using ESE methods on user-generated text, highlighting the unique challenges and characteristics of such text that necessitate specialized evaluation metrics.

claims.text: ESE methods are evaluated on user-generated text to understand their generalizability and performance in the presence of non-named, multifaceted, and vague entities that are more common in this type of text.
The proposed evaluation metrics for ESE methods are designed to address the unique characteristics of user-generated text, which are not adequately represented by traditional metrics.
